blurb: This site stretches 2km along a beautiful pebble beach and offers a chance to camp right on Harrison Lake. Camping is for tents only on the pebble beach, with no tables and a rock fire ring. There are 6 forested tent sites with tables located in a treed area accessible by foot along short trails below the Site Operator area. The rest of the camping is off the main road and directly on the beach.
